security_summary: Senior secured; first-priority blanket lien on substantially all personal property of the Borrower and Guarantors (accounts, inventory, equipment, deposit accounts, general intangibles/IP, equity of domestic subsidiaries), subject to customary exclusions. Source: executed Security Agreement and Credit Agreement, Initial Closing.
_no_goodwill_note: Borrower's Balance Sheet carries no goodwill line, so no goodwill-tier component or 'ex-goodwill' cut is defined.
